## Download

Download **`Rastro-v0.3.0-windows-x64.exe`** below and run it. There's nothing to install. Windows will probably warn you the first time because the file isn't signed: click **More info → Run anyway**. The [README](https://github.com/MaxSala/rastro-tarkov#download) explains why and walks through the first launch.

Your settings, points and downloaded maps are kept when you replace an older version.

## What's new

**Keys on the map**
- New *Locks* layer with every door, container and car trunk that needs a key. Locks that need power have a yellow outline.
- Click a lock to see which key opens it, the cheapest place to buy it and its best sell price.
- *Highlight this key* dims every other lock, so you can see everything one key opens.
- In the Market, each key now lists the installed maps it's used on, with a link straight to it.
- To get the locks, re-download your maps from the Maps panel with *Update from tarkov.dev*.

**16 languages**
- The interface now speaks every language tarkov.dev supports: Čeština, Deutsch, English, Español, Français, Magyar, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Polski, Português, Română, Русский, Slovenčina, Türkçe and 中文. Pick yours in *Settings → General*.
- Item, map and extract names come from tarkov.dev in the same language. Re-download maps and prices after switching.
- Translations other than Spanish and English haven't been reviewed by native speakers yet. Corrections are welcome on [Discord](https://discord.gg/H4pRxGBGDb).

**Fixes**
- A map with an unnamed lock in tarkov.dev's data no longer gets rejected when installing.
- The Market no longer sticks to the previous catalog after changing language or game mode.

## Also in 0.2.0

Market price search, ammo table, loading screen and the new logo. Full history on the [releases page](https://github.com/MaxSala/rastro-tarkov/releases).
